description: This file defines the Candidate entity class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It models a job candidate with properties such as name, email, application mode, and associated relations to vacancies, attachments, and history. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying candidate attributes.
external_methods: Methods in related entities like Employee, CandidateVacancy, CandidateAttachment, CandidateHistory
